## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
library(ggplot2)

## P protein complete
felfubar_HPIV2_P_long <- felfubar_HPIV2_P_long %>% mutate(
    symbol = case_when(
      class_fel == "diversifying" & class_fubar == "diversifying" & seleccion == "beta" ~ "*",
      class_fel == "purifying" & class_fubar == "purifying"   & seleccion == "alpha_neg" ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    ypos = ifelse(valor >= 0, valor + 0.2, valor - 0.2)  # posicion del simbolo
  )

felfubar_HPIV2_P_plot <- ggplot(felfubar_HPIV2_P_long, aes(x = factor(codon), y = valor, fill = seleccion)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity", width = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("alpha_neg" = "#e6ab02", "beta" = "#1b9e77")) +

  # Agregar simbolos sobre las barras cuando los dos test son significativos
  geom_text(aes(label = symbol, y = ypos),
            na.rm = TRUE,
            size = 5) +
  #plot style
  theme_classic() + labs(x= NULL, y=NULL) + theme(legend.position = "none") + scale_x_discrete(labels = NULL)

### V since the overlap region

felfubar_HPIV2_V_long <- felfubar_HPIV2_V_long %>% mutate(

      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),

  )

felfubar_HPIV2_V_plot <- ggplot(felfubar_HPIV2_V_long, aes(x = factor(codon), y = valor, fill = seleccion)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "identity", width = 0.8) +

  # Agregar simbolos sobre las barras cuando los dos test son significativos

felfubar_HPIV2_V_plot
